scripts.build:supabase-production: tsc -b && vite build --mode supabase-production && npm run verify:production-bundle
scripts.test: cross-env VITE_SUPABASE_BACKEND_TARGET=local-demo VITE_SUPABASE_SANDBOX_PROBE_ENABLED=false vitest run tests/unit tests/integration
scripts.test:business-logic: cross-env VITE_SUPABASE_BACKEND_TARGET=local-demo VITE_SUPABASE_SANDBOX_PROBE_ENABLED=false vitest run tests/unit --exclude "tests/unit/**/*.tsx"
scripts.test:e2e:supabase:production: npm run verify:supabase-ui-e2e && npm run verify:supabase-production-ui-e2e && cross-env SUPABASE_PRODUCTION_E2E_UNLOCK=1 playwright test --config config/playwright/playwright.supabase-production-ui.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:supabase:production:lifecycle: npm run build:supabase-production && cross-env V19_PRODUCTION_LIFECYCLE_FRESH_BUILD=1 playwright test --config config/playwright/playwright.supabase-production-lifecycle.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:supabase:production:family-cont: npm run build:supabase-production && cross-env V19_PRODUCTION_FAMILY_CONTACT_FRESH_BUILD=1 playwright test --config config/playwright/playwright.supabase-production-family-contact.config.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run verify:deployment-headers && npm run verify:safety && npm run verify:repo-hygiene && npm run verify:codex-hook && npm run verify:agent-screen-system && npm run verify:v19-boundary && npm run verify:v19-ui-proof && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:performance
scripts.verify:local-readiness: npm run verify && npm run verify:security && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify:local-readiness && npm run verify:auth-data-readiness && npm run verify:supabase-release && npm run verify:production-packet
scripts.verify:e2e-fastlane: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:smoke && npm run test:e2e:pilot
scripts.verify:e2e-localhost: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:smoke && npm run test:e2e:focused
scripts.verify:e2e-focused-root: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:smoke && npm run test:e2e:focused
